proposed_rules.trigger: A node tagged [region] appears as a sibling far from its logical container (including near page root), with content matching a collapsed FAQ answer that overlaps the y-coordinates of a different question's slot.
proposed_rules.decision: Re-associate each [region] node with its matching question by content adjacency rather than by tree position; merge into the parent block's row.
proposed_rules.rationale: Several answer regions here (rc2c12c2c7, c8, c9, rc2c12c3, rc4) occupy y-ranges overlapping other questions' slots, confirming the accordion's collapsed-panel DOM order does not match visual order after capture; a naive position-based join would misattribute answers to the wrong question.
